title: [Bug] Model generates a synthetic next user turn instead of answering after a denied tool call

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a clear, actionable bug report detailing a specific regression/bug where the model generates a synthetic user message instead of an assistant response following a denied tool call with an accompanying clarification question. Complete environment details and reproduction context are included.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Fixing the handling of denied tool calls accompanied by user queries requires refining system prompt guidelines in core and adjusting tool response/history composition in the CLI streaming hook, as well as writing unit test coverage.

summary.problem: When a tool call (such as write_file) is denied by the user and accompanied by a clarification question, the model generates synthetic user text predicting the next turn instead of answering as the assistant.
summary.root_cause: Packaging a denied function response together with user prompt text into a single user turn without explicit turn-boundary guidance causes the model to misinterpret the state and output text from the user perspective.
summary.context: The synthetic user message gets persisted into conversation history as model output, contaminating the session state.

steps: Update the tool confirmation protocol instructions in packages/core/src/prompts/snippets.ts to explicitly instruct the model to answer user questions accompanying denied tool calls rather than simulating next user turns.

Refactor history turn construction in packages/cli/src/ui/hooks/useGeminiStream.ts to ensure user prompt text submitted with a tool call denial is properly structured alongside functionResponse parts.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When a tool call is denied with an accompanying user question, the model responds as an assistant addressing the question.
verification_steps: Add a unit test simulating tool call denial accompanied by user text input.
Assert that the generated response is processed as model assistant output answering the user query.
